correctness.rationale: The main law survives; the frozen slogan and the final high-m step of the proof included the degenerate point m=1 where the standardization divides by zero. The revised files make 1/sqrt(2)<=m<1 explicit, note S=1 in the geometric fiber at m=1, and distinguish numerical diagnostics from proof. In an ordered positive sector use (m,r cos θ,r sin θ), r=√(1-m²). The surface metric determinant is one, so the folded probability measure is (48/(4π))dm dθ. Ordering imposes θ between max(0,arccos(m/r)) (interpreted as zero for m>=r) and π/4. S=m+√2 r sin(θ+π/4) is monotone inside with derivative b-c. This gives the density, support and exact angular uniformity, as well as f_M=3 above the threshold. Coordinate/tie sets have area zero; the inverse square-root upper-edge singularity integrates and there is no boundary atom. Independent sector integrals give E[S]=3/2, E[M]=3√2 arccos(1/3)/(2π), E[SM]=1/3+2√2/π. For replay, reverse integration order: m>=g(θ)=cosθ/√(1+cos²θ), θ∈[0,π/4]; the cross moment is (4/π) times the integral of 1-g³+(cosθ+sinθ)(1-g²)^(3/2). The two terms integrate to π/12+1/(2√3) and 1/√2-1/(2√3). CHECK.py was inspected, not executed; its 599 comparisons are floating point.
